Good coffee chill out spot
Dec 2019
My dad and I came here to have a cuppa while the rest of the family went shopping. It was a nice quaint spot in an unassumingly lane (you could easily miss it!). Has a bakery shop next to it that sells yummy pastries and cream puffs. Dad tried the coconut coffee while I had the glutinous black rice coffee - was a unique flavour with interesting texture from the black rice, in a good way! Staff were very pleasant. Also has free wifi and charging points for techies who need a spot to do some work!
